description: The place each activity's answers are stored.

fields.label: Section Key
fields.description: The key an activity question names to say where its answer is stored.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: The name these answers carry where no heading is shown.

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: The order sections are resolved in.

fields.label: Target DocType
fields.description: The record type these answers are stored on.

fields.label: Child Table Field
fields.description: The table on the activity holding these rows. Left blank, the section is the activity record itself.

fields.label: Is Multi Row
fields.description: Not available to an activity section. A question asked many times is declared in a section that stores one row per question instead.

fields.label: Row Key Field
fields.description: The field that identifies one row. Where Is Key Value is ticked, it holds the question a row answers.

fields.label: Is Key Value
fields.description: One row per question rather than one column per question, so a new question can be added without changing the database.

fields.label: Value Field
fields.description: The field holding the answer. Required when Is Key Value is ticked.

fields.label: Label Field
fields.description: The field holding what the answer is called. An activity's label lives on its activity type, so this is left blank.

fields.label: Question Field
fields.description: The field holding the question a row answers. Required when Is Key Value is ticked.

name: CRM Task Section
